title: SvgFeMerge
responsibility: Renders the native feMerge element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeMerge.attributes
inputs.description: Native feMerge attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeMerge.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feMerge element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeMerge
outputs.description: The actual native feMerge element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
